variables.name: redirect_uri
variables.label: OAuth Redirect URI
variables.helpText: Public URL of this widget. Must match URL in SideDrawer OAuth app settings.

variables.name: client_id
variables.label: SideDrawer Client ID
variables.helpText: OAuth2 Client ID from your SideDrawer OAuth application.

variables.name: keycloak_url
variables.label: Keycloak Base URL
variables.helpText: Base URL of the Keycloak server (e.g. https://auth.example.com). Leave blank, along with Realm, to use the 'preset' value instead.

variables.name: realm
variables.label: Keycloak Realm
variables.helpText: Keycloak realm name. Required together with Keycloak Base URL — if either is blank, 'preset' is used instead.

variables.name: preset
variables.label: Realm Preset
variables.helpText: Named realm preset to use when Keycloak Base URL/Realm are not both set. Only 'local' (the bundled docker-compose realm) ships built in — add your own environment presets to KC_PRESETS in app/widget.html as they become known. Unrecognised values fall back to 'local'.

variables.name: environment
variables.label: Environment (API routing)
variables.helpText: Only used to pick SideDrawer API hosts when Keycloak Base URL is set and its host isn't one of the built-in presets: 'sandbox', 'production' or 'development'.

variables.name: idp_hint
variables.label: Identity Provider Hint
variables.helpText: Optional Keycloak kc_idp_hint value to skip the realm's login form and go straight to a specific identity provider.
